pondSite.name: Candidate #1 (Recommended)
pondSite.reason: Optimal pond site selected: ~463m safe buffer from drainage channel to prevent river inundation; natural micro-depression (5.72m depth); gentle slope; concave terrain convergence (100% surrounding higher ground); significant flow accumulation from upstream slopes (accum: 15).
pros: Natural micro-depression (5.72m depth) minimizes excavation needs
High upstream runoff accumulation (flow accum: 15)
Safe distance (~463m) from main drainage channel prevents flood breach
cons: Slight terrain gradient; requires site leveling during pond bunding
Higher relative elevation compared to surrounding valley floor

waterVolume.formula: V = Catchment Area (m²) × Rainfall Depth (m) × Runoff Coefficient (C)
waterVolume.assumptions: Rainfall: 100.0 mm | Soil Runoff Coefficient: 0.7 (clay/loam pond basin)
